title: fix(ci): skip SDK rendering for identical revisions
body:
## What Problem This Solves
SDK API comparisons installed and rendered revisions even when different refs resolved to the same commit. That redundant work could fail an unchanged comparison.

## User Impact
Identical revisions now produce the normal empty API diff without creating render worktrees or installing dependencies. Runtime and published plugin SDK behavior are unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made
Resolve and validate every ref first, then render only unequal comparisons. Both paths use the same ordered payload and digest constructor, preserving JSON, reports, release evidence, and acknowledgement handling.

Regression coverage checks aliases, dirty caller state, equal and mixed selectors, invalid inputs, and cancellation across distinct commits. Tooling and internal implementation: +18 net lines; tests: +127.

## Evidence

- Signed PR head: `f8de8e16ce8cd72b5e742c60e682b199e474f21b`. [CI run 34791219341, attempt 1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34791219341/attempts/1) tested synthetic merge `1146a072b049ed551ae27ce09b640bd849431810`: **SUCCESS**, 135 jobs (118 succeeded, 17 skipped), including `openclaw/ci-gate`, owning production/test type checks, lint, guards, and build.
- [`test/scripts/plugin-sdk-api-diff.test.ts`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34791219341/job/103815809287): **10 passed**.
- [`src/plugin-sdk/api-baseline.test.ts`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34791219341/job/103815807798): **22 passed**.
- [`test/scripts/plugin-sdk-api-release-evidence.test.ts`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34791219341/job/103815809213): **9 passed**.
- All 41 named cases passed with no named skips. Each job's actual checkout, decoded suite selector, and normal group exit were verified from its retained log. Other tests in those groups retained their existing skips.
- PASS: pinned oxfmt 0.66.0 for all three changed files, `git diff --check`, and independent final-diff review. [Exact-head ClawSweeper review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/147572#issuecomment-5657247544): no findings; Before merge: None.

The shortcut avoids the equal-revision renderer path. The separate renderer heap-exhaustion issue for mixed or distinct revisions remains outside this change.

### Focused base-red / candidate-green proof

- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01m2f3eze3gdh1xr0hvw5g0dj7`, [run 34806929929](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34806929929), verified source `f8de8e16ce8cd72b5e742c60e682b199e474f21b` and tree `c12eaa234581d9a68bace1ef400c06163ab802e0`.
- **Base red:** retained the candidate equal-alias regression test while restoring both production files from merge base `d271a071a877d59f2f6377c3f3432e7fa0370472`. The fake `pnpm` exited `97` and created `PNPM_MARKER`; the outer CLI exited `1`, and stderr contained `Plugin SDK revision install failed`. The focused Vitest invocation failed exactly that one test with nine filtered. Output SHA-256: stdout `d75c5ff97ac32ec72d661ed624d282dc2116100b804ce3a8c9ba7eb12fff0c9c`; stderr `644741fc845ef40106e8774b09fe8f6a64376d00d8e69d6ec58b9ef7a2915436`.
- **Candidate green:** restored both exact candidate blobs and reran only the equal-alias test. Result: one passed, nine filtered, no install marker, clean candidate tree. Output SHA-256: stdout `f2d27f1f3c252c33aa77c07636811dcbc81694fd8b37aad4355baf8bcb13d9e0`; stderr `3587272319976adc514cfec76e1d4e69dd35c53904ff3f2ad6f211d811414a10`.
